query:
SELECT name, dayOfWeek, startTime, endTime, time 
FROM classes 
WHERE dayOfWeek LIKE '%Saturday%' OR dayOfWeek LIKE '%Sat%'
AND isActive = 1 
AND organizationId = 180001
ORDER BY startTime;
